subject.title: feat(ui): redesign composer run-status indicator as chrome-free status text

question: Should the Control UI adopt this chrome-free pulsing-dot and text-wave treatment as the canonical composer run-status design?
rationale: The implementation is correct and well-proven, but whether composer activity should become less prominent is a subjective visual hierarchy decision protected for explicit owner review.

options.title: Approve unified status styling
options.body: Refresh the branch onto current main and merge the focused design after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Keep composer status distinct
options.body: Retain the existing bordered treatment if composer activity is intentionally meant to be more prominent than transcript tool activity.

recommendation.title: Approve unified status styling
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch onto current main and merge the focused design after exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Earlier merged history ties both visual treatments and the affected Control UI boundaries to this person, making them the strongest available design-decision owner.
